behavior: Walks and wades while foraging, flipping leaves and debris; often forms small flocks and may mix with other blackbirds.
field_marks: Pale yellow eyes contrast with a dark face
Dark brown to black body with rusty feather edging outside the breeding season
Buffy eyebrow, especially prominent in nonbreeding plumage
Rounded wings and a medium-length, square-tipped to slightly rounded tail
habitat: Wet forests and freshwater margins, including wooded swamps, bogs, muskeg, marshes, flooded woods, beaver ponds, and pond or stream edges.
